name: Session History
description: Contributes the SessionHistory tool: paginated, filterable read access to the recorded transcript of any saved session (this one or a past one) straight from the append-only JSONL store. Window records from the start or the end with stable indexes, list/search sessions, filter tool calls by name, read spilled raw tool-output blobs, or produce the full markdown/XML dump that --dump prints. Fully decoupled: it reads only through the ctx.host capability surface (sessions:read, blobs:read) and imports nothing from the host. Not the same as SessionInfo, which reports the live runtime state (context fullness, quota, cost) of the current run.

tool.name: SessionHistory
tool.description: Read the recorded conversation history of a session from the on-disk transcript store (~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.jsonl) - this session's earlier turns or any past session. This is the archival/transcript counterpart to SessionInfo: call SessionInfo for your live runtime state (context %, quota, cost, uptime); call SessionHistory to read back what was actually said and done, here or in another session. Actions: 'window' (default) pages records with stable indexes - default is the latest 10 records (anchor 'end'); use anchor 'start' + offset/limit to walk forward, or grow limit for more; 'meta' summarizes a session (model, cwd, created, record counts, first prompt, liveness, blob count); 'list' enumerates saved sessions newest-first (filter by query/cwd, paginate); 'search' greps text across one session (sid set) or recent sessions (sid omitted); 'tool_calls' filters tool invocations by tool name ('the last 3 times Bash ran'); 'blob' reads the full pre-truncation output of one tool call by tool_use_id; 'dump' renders the entire session as markdown or XML (large - prefer 'window' unless the user wants everything). sid defaults to 'last' (the most recent session for this cwd, else globally) and also accepts any unique prefix of a full session id (e.g. '260d72dd'). Results are bounded: previews clip per record (previewChars) and every response reports total counts plus the offsets to fetch the next page.

sid.description: Target session id, full id or any unique prefix (e.g. '260d72dd'), or 'last' (default) for the most recent session in this cwd (falling back to the globally most recent). An ambiguous prefix errors with the matching candidates. Not needed for 'list', optional for 'search'.

anchor.description: window: page from the oldest record ('start') or the newest ('end', default).

offset.description: window/list/search/tool_calls: records to skip from the anchor. Default 0.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults: window 10 (max 500), list 25, search 20, tool_calls 20.

previewChars.description: window/search: per-record body clip in characters. Default 600 (window) / 160 (search).

query.description: search: case-insensitive substring to find. list: filter sessions by sid/cwd substring.

cwd.description: list: only sessions whose recorded cwd equals this path.

tool.description: tool_calls: only invocations of this tool name (e.g. 'Bash'). Omit for all tools.

toolUseId.description: blob: the tool_use id whose raw spilled output to read.

maxBytes.description: blob: clamp the returned blob text to this many bytes. Default 65536.

tool.reason: perfect collision: plugin IS the tool name
